purpose: sampled 48-landmark backend feasibility before any full-rate control action analysis

timing.sampling: frame 0, every 15th decoded frame, and final decoded frame

backend.mode: CatDetectionMode.faceOnly on two preregistered spatial ROIs

roi_basis: pre-existing deterministic control contact sheets generated before this probe; the two cats remain spatially separated in the frozen scene
duplicate_face_guard: if returned face centers are closer than 8 percent of the full-frame diagonal, mark the frame REVIEW_DUPLICATE_FACE_RISK

preflight_outcomes.PASS_CANDIDATE_ONLY: both ROI channels return one structurally valid 48-point face on the sampled frame and the face centers are spatially distinct
preflight_outcomes.REVIEW: one channel is missing/ambiguous or duplicate-face risk is triggered
preflight_outcomes.NO_CLAIM: sampled control feasibility never establishes action onset or delta-t

admission_boundary.full_rate_control_analysis: requires a separately frozen gate after this preflight

claim_ceiling: This preflight tests whether the pinned open 48-landmark backend can produce two spatially distinct candidate faces on a deterministic 83-frame sample of the conflict control. It does not establish landmark accuracy, CatFACS actions, action onset, mimicry, or latency.
